sections.heading: The teams are set
sections.text: Gemma’s teams turn back to their workbenches. Entry and team mergers closed Wednesday. Now each test has to earn its place. Kaggle caps uploads at one a day. The final submission deadline is 2 December 2026, 23:59 UTC.

sections.heading: Pick what goes in the case
sections.text:
Teams can pick up to two submissions for final judging. If a team makes no choice, Kaggle handles the selection. Each agent writes patches for software issues. Its score is the share of patched repositories that pass the validation tests. The private board uses a separate test set to rank the entries and determine the potential winners.

That makes the last upload and the final selection two different calls. If one build shines on the public board, does a team send another version of it or give a different approach a seat?
